title: 1.3 Front-End Development
description: Client-side development using HTML, CSS and JavaScript

questions.question: Front-end development refers to the practice of building which of the following?
options: C. Correctness of input and programming of instructions
Procedures for installing new software on old computers
The user-facing aspects of websites or web applications
Lying back with the monitor at eye level below the desk
questions.correctAnswer: The user-facing aspects of websites or web applications
